Question: Show the latest sensor reading recorded for asset REL-003.

rank_trace.sql: SELECT s.reading_time, s.sensor_type, s.reading_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings s JOIN assets a ON s.asset_id = a.asset_id WHERE a.asset_id = 'REL-003' ORDER BY s.reading_time DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.reading_time, s.sensor_type, s.reading_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings s JOIN assets a ON s.asset_id = a.asset_id JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id WHERE a.asset_id = 'REL-003' ORDER BY s.reading_time DESC LIMIT 1;

raw_response:
1.  SELECT s.reading_time, s.sensor_type, s.reading_value, s.unit  
    FROM sensor_readings s  
    JOIN assets a ON s.asset_id = a.asset_id  
    WHERE a.asset_id = 'REL-003'  
    ORDER BY s.reading_time DESC  
    LIMIT 1;

2.  SELECT s.reading_time, s.sensor_type, s.reading_value, s.unit  
    FROM sensor_readings s  
    JOIN assets a ON s.asset_id = a.asset_id  
    JOIN asset_types t ON a.asset_type_id = t.asset_type_id  
    WHERE a.asset_id = 'REL-003'  
    ORDER BY s.reading_time DESC  
    LIMIT 1;

3.  SELECT s.reading_time, s.sensor_type, s.reading_value, s.unit  
    FROM sensor_readings s  
    JOIN assets a ON s.asset_id = a.asset_id  
    JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id  
    WHERE a.asset_id = 'REL-003'  
    ORDER BY s.reading_time DESC  
    LIMIT 1;
